chain.name: workshop
chain.description: Create the three-section chapter frame: Workshop (arrival/scene), Story (main material), Discussion (reflection). Grounds the chapter in the epic and chapter plan.

chain.name: research
chain.description: Deepen and verify chapter material. Attach era, place, figures, events, sources, and grounding notes. Flatten workshop scaffolding into continuous prose.

chain.name: seeds
chain.description: Curate the chapter seed: select included characters, set quality parameters, write mood-shaped chapter summary, lay out segment structure.

chain.name: correctness
chain.description: Verify all factual claims: species names, geographic data, historical dates, attribution of sources. Record corrections and uncertainties.

chain.name: theme
chain.description: Assign the chapter theme, theme essence, contemporary mapping (urban ecology / sustainability), and form-consistent stereotype selection.

chain.name: syntax
chain.description: Apply syntax guidance: keep the prose elevated, modern, and readable. Short declarative field sentences; lyrical reflective passages. Never ornate.
